tracked_summary_note: This tracked file is a CURATED SUMMARY of the orchestration registry, whose authoritative copy is schema/worker-policy.json in the private repo x-cessive/XCSV_ORCH and is shipped inside each verified release. It is intentionally smaller and is NOT a byte copy: the release copy carries machine-local probe detail and absolute paths that do not belong in the public repo. Reconcile by curating, never by overwriting.

runtime_integrity.chain: canonical commit -> releases\<commit>\manifest.json (per-file SHA256) -> CURRENT.json (release id + manifest SHA256) -> load-time verification -> execution
runtime_integrity.fail_mode: INTEGRITY_BLOCKED - no dispatch, no self-repair, no silent redeploy, no fallback to unverified local code
runtime_integrity.toctou: CLOSED for loaded modules: Import-XcsvVerifiedModule reads bytes once, hashes those bytes, and executes those same bytes as a scriptblock.
runtime_integrity.state_root_rule: Resolved explicitly via Get-XcsvStateRoot, never from $PSScriptRoot. Releases must never contain state/, handoffs/, runs/, hermes-home/ or a baton; a test asserts this.
runtime_integrity.root_of_trust_limit: Terminates at CURRENT.json plus the integrity module. An attacker with write access to the runtime root could rewrite pointer, manifest and code together. No code signing or OS-enforced immutable store is in place.
